hero.description: Maastricht, the Netherlands. View of Randwyck, the business and university district in the southeast of Maastricht. To the left the University Hospital. To the right the School for Midwifery ( Academie Verloskunde ), part of Zuyd University of Applied Sciences. Untill 2013 the building also housed BioPartner (or Brains Unlimited ), part of the Maastricht Health Campus. In 2013 Brains Unlimited moved to a new building in Oxfordlaan.)
